pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-pointed, amoeboid dark regions with jagged, low-gradient pixel edges. Patches exhibit variable spatial area with a non-geometric, star-like distribution across the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, high-continuity cream-colored pathways forming a dense topological grid. Junction nodes are broad with significant pixel thickness relative to the neighboring patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, fine, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the neck and shoulder line, exhibiting a soft fringe transition against the background pixels.
